headline: OPay Raises $304 Million in New York Stock Exchange Debut
summary: Nigerian mobile payments company OPay began trading on the New York Stock Exchange on October 30, raising $304 million in its listing.
why: OPay is a leading fintech platform in Africa. Listings of African tech companies on major US exchanges provide liquidity benchmarks for emerging-market venture investments.

impacts.name: OPay
impacts.why: OPay successfully completed an initial public offering on the NYSE, raising $304 million.
